title: Spirit of Orca Whale Watching, Wildlife, & Birding Tours

services.name: Whale Tales
services.desc: “The Sea, once it casts its spell, holds one in its net of wonder forever.” Jacques Cousteau On today’s two tours, we saw minke whales and orcas, the T75Bs. Our first stop was at the rocks to see Ottis, the sea otter, eating green sea urchins. We stopped off to see a pair of marbled murrelets. This little bird is endangered. They fish here and fly about fifty miles inshore to get to their nest. They will only nest in old-growth forests; not much old-growth is left.
